correctness.rationale: For all real 0<a<=b<=c the proof derives L from small-radius ball volume, diameter (b+c)/2, exact theta four-path cross-arm distance constraints, terminal law 4e(a+e) for e<(b-a)/2 when a<b, positive first-order deviations after its sharp endpoint, and separate tied-arm slopes.
